strategies.name: Buy & Hold
strategies.tagline: Buy on the first bar, never sell.
strategies.weakness: Takes the full drawdown of every crash, in full, every time.

strategies.name: SMA Crossover
strategies.tagline: Buy when the fast average crosses above the slow one.
strategies.weakness: Whipsaws badly in a sideways market, paying a fee on every false cross.

params.label: Fast period
params.help: Bars in the fast average. Lower reacts sooner and trades more.

params.label: Slow period
params.help: Bars in the slow average. Must be longer than the fast one.

strategies.name: EMA Crossover
strategies.tagline: A crossover that weights recent bars more heavily.
strategies.weakness: Reacts sooner than SMA, and therefore to more noise.

params.label: Fast period
params.help: Bars in the fast average.

params.label: Slow period
params.help: Bars in the slow average.

strategies.name: MACD Trend
strategies.tagline: Long while MACD is above its signal line.
strategies.weakness: A lagging indicator of a lagging indicator; late in and late out.

params.label: Fast period
params.help: Fast EMA of the MACD line.

params.label: Slow period
params.help: Slow EMA of the MACD line.

params.label: Signal period
params.help: EMA taken over the MACD line itself.

strategies.name: RSI Reversion
strategies.weakness: Buys every step of the way down in a real trend.

params.label: RSI period
params.help: Bars in the RSI window.

params.label: Oversold level
params.help: Buy when RSI crosses below this.

params.label: Overbought level
params.help: Sell when RSI crosses above this.

strategies.name: Bollinger Breakout
strategies.tagline: Buy a close above the upper band, exit at the middle.
strategies.weakness: A quiet market makes the bands narrow, and every wiggle a breakout.

params.label: Band period
params.help: Bars in the moving average the bands sit around.

params.label: Deviations
params.help: Standard deviations to the upper and lower band.

strategies.name: Donchian Breakout
strategies.tagline: Buy a new N-bar high, sell a new M-bar low.
strategies.weakness: Gives back a fixed slice of every trend before it exits.

params.label: Entry lookback
params.help: Bars in the high that triggers entry.

params.label: Exit lookback
params.help: Bars in the low that triggers exit.

strategies.name: ATR Trailing Stop
strategies.tagline: Enter above trend, exit on a volatility-scaled trailing stop.
strategies.weakness: A volatility spike stops it out of a trend that then continues without it.

params.label: Trend period
params.help: Average the close must exceed to enter.

params.label: ATR period
params.help: Bars in the average true range.

params.label: ATR multiple
params.help: How many ATRs below the peak the stop sits.

strategies.name: Grid
strategies.tagline: Buy a rung on every step down from the running high.
strategies.weakness: Fills every rung and holds the lot through a market that never comes back.

params.label: Rungs
params.help: Slices the allocation is divided into.

params.label: Spacing
params.help: Percent fall between one rung and the next.

strategies.name: Dollar-Cost Average
strategies.tagline: Buy a fixed slice every N bars until fully invested.
strategies.weakness: Ignores price entirely, which is the point and also the cost.

params.label: Interval
params.help: Bars between one slice and the next.

params.label: Slices
params.help: Purchases the allocation is divided into.
